briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 deployments accelerate AGI timeline amid global compute scramble

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs are releasing agentic systems at unprecedented pace while governments scramble for regulatory footing. Compute shortages and talent wars define the current phase of the AGI race.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with native tool use; xAI released Grok-4 achieving new benchmarks on agentic tasks. Anthropic and Google DeepMind followed with Claude 4 and Gemini 3 variants focused on long-context reasoning.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime verification for multi-agent environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips; Microsoft and CoreWeave announced $4B joint data center expansion in Texas targeting 2027 capacity.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialect negotiation become mandatory standards before the first AGI deployment?
